description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of sentiment analysis results for two categories—“Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweets”—when using three different text annotation tools: TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT. The horizontal axis categorizes the data into two groups: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweets,” while the vertical axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8. Each category contains three bars, corresponding to the three tools, with distinct visual patterns: TEXTBLOB is represented by a white bar, VADER by a diagonally striped bar, and ChatGPT by a solid green bar. In the “Emoji Tweets” group, ChatGPT achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 0.68, followed by VADER at around 0.48, and TEXTBLOB at about 0.42. In the “Overall Tweets” group, ChatGPT again shows the highest accuracy, at approximately 0.66, while VADER and TEXTBLOB are both around 0.48. The chart clearly indicates that ChatGPT outperforms both TEXTBLOB and VADER across both tweet types, with the highest accuracy observed in the “Emoji Tweets” category.
